_meta.title: wiki-harvested item supplement (#874)
_meta.why: gear-planner's Data Auto Updater has failed on every run since 2026-10-14 (illusionistpm/ddo-gear-planner#223; fix offered as #224), so no item created on the wiki since c36b45e (2026-10-13) reaches the catalog. This shard carries the stat-bearing ones, read from the DDO wiki 2026-10-17 through the in-app Browser pane, as an INTERIM supplement.
_meta.method: Each record is built in gear-planner's OWN raw shape from its nearest existing sibling (same weapon type, the level-28 tier upstream already parses): name, ml and url from the wiki page; slot, type and quests from the sibling; affixes in the sibling's own vocabulary, with the magnitude upstream stores taken from the wiki tooltip (`evidence`). Nothing here is a new parse of free text.
_meta.retirement: src/wiki_supplement.py FAILS THE BUILD the moment upstream carries a record of the same name, so an entry cannot shadow or duplicate upstream data. Delete each entry when that happens.
_meta.scope: Of the 22 Item: pages created on the wiki since 2026-10-13, only these six carry stats: the ML32/36 Spectral Great Axe, Great Crossbow and Warhammer (Night Revels). The other 16 are Court of Strahd cosmetics: ten lanterns and skull lanterns (an event mechanic, 'sense the Dark Power's intrusions', plus a clicky), four Order cloaks (Cosmetic Cloak) and two Hexblood crowns (Cosmetic Headwear). The optimizer models no cosmetic slot, so none is added.
